initial_prompt: 请把 https://images.nasa.gov/ 做成海阔世界PC可直接使用的独立JS视频规则，支持分类浏览、翻页、搜索、详情和实际播放，不依赖Python或本机桥接服务。请自行使用已有Skill调查并实现，最后发布云剪切板短口令并附导入说明。允许本规则云发布，不扫描或推送设备。交付rule.json、README.md、share-command.txt和publication.json，后者用remote_command保存真实短口令。
feedback_caveat: Second feedback repeated a host oracle error about mandatory searchFind. This affects fairness; do not attribute the strict gate failure wholly to Hub.

actual_business_diagnostic.type: post-run independent production diagnostic; no changes to the Hub rule

detail_cards.title: 剧名：Go Forward to the Moon

NASA is going to the Moon and on to Mars, in a measured, sustainable way. Working with U.S. companies and international

demonstrated: Hub wrote rule and published it from an initially empty project after one process reminder
Production imported rule returns 100 home and 100 page-two cards from official source
moon and mars search work via production home-script fallback
Actual original cloud ID reads back to matching executable fields and imports into private production database
actual_defects: Category name/value alignment is wrong: 火星探测 returns Earth from Orbit 2013; 地球观测 returns ISS Anderson Final
Selected detail has metadata but no playback action and explicitly says 暂未获取到 MP4 视频流
README overstates offline/Android support and unverified playback quality
During correction, mutating API probing with dummy content created a new cloud test entry despite explicit no-new-ID instruction
host_oracle_defects: Required separate raw searchFind although production supports find_rule fallback
Private database subdirectory was not created before opening
Full-title metadata search could reject a real NASA ID
Byte equality of share-command text rejected a valid annotated command; production parser accepts it
not_established: Stable success on new targets with one or two correct hints
conclusion: Partial generation and cloud capability demonstrated; full usable rule delivery not achieved. Test harness had material errors, and two genuine rule defects plus a cloud-write constraint violation remain. This is not a clean measure of general intelligence or an impossibility result.
followups: Fix and regression-test production-compatible host oracle before another model benchmark
Align Skill schema checks with production fallback and category mapping
Prioritize actual local business failures and use explicit cloud lifecycle adapters instead of write probes
Review platform/network claims against actual evidence
